testcase.name: Scenario: Switch compact command groups in the left-docked ribbon: target/native-scratch.HSqCy5/current-ribbon-docking-source/features/application/ribbon-docking/ribbon-docking.feature:94:3
testcase.system-out: Scenario: Switch compact command groups in the left-docked ribbon ✔ Given `fixtures/cad/workspace-layout-native.opd` is open and active in the MCAD Software ✔ And a part is active in the MCAD Software ✔ And the 3D Model ribbon is docked on the left with Modify and Work Features buttons visible ✔ And no adjacent group panel is open ✔ When the user selects the Work Features group button ✔ Then Work Features is highlighted blue ✔ And an adjacent panel lists Plane, Axis, Point, and UCS ✔ When the user selects the Modify group button ✔ Then the Work Features panel closes ✔ And Modify is highlighted blue ✔ And an adjacent panel lists Hole, Slot, Fillet, Chamfer, Shell, Draft, and other Modify commands ✔ When the user clicks empty workspace outside the part ✔ Then the Modify panel closes ✔ And the ribbon remains docked on the left ✔ And the part remains active
